label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform and Conversational AI
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: 27 AI-server listings reached production by 22 Sep, all disabled pending approval. Category disable is 36 of 38 tasks done. Returns flow is in testing, and wizard steps 2 and 3 closed on 23 Sep. Home page, PDP and listing stories are still past their 31 Aug due dates.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: Production smoke tests pass on all 250 URLs the sitemap exposes, but more than 500 are expected. Figma validation has raised 31 defects, 8 of them on 23 Sep, and 7 are fixed. No open item is past its due date.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: Highest throughput in scope, with 400 issues closed in 30 days. That includes 278 older issues closed in one clean-up on 11 Sep. 72 bugs are still open, 2 of them S1. Seven items are past due, including Platform Security & Access Control since 15 Aug, and two are marked as blockers.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: Five delivery stories are done: the Marketing, Services Platform and Marketplace chatbots, conversational UX and the admin dashboard. Book a Meeting is overdue since 4 Sep. Eight new agent stories are in To Do with no due dates.
